posts.title: A kid-friendly DIY jukebox
posts.description: I grew up in the music CD era, which meant I could take a look at our family CD collection, pick what I wanted to listen to, pop it into a CD player and voila, music! The collection was not that big, it was music that my parents liked, but at least I had agency . I could listen to music without involving anyone else from a very young age.
